en: Sepia-toned rural view with a wooden farmhouse in the foreground, its shingled roof sloping low to the ground and a ladder leaning against it. A large tree stands beside the house next to a winding dirt path that leads across gently rolling fields toward a small village on a hill. In the distance there is a church with a tower and a few other buildings. The word "Schellerhau" is printed in the upper left corner.
